anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: The first-pass snapshot wording moved the budget fact: After appends `row 1 passed | first done | attempts 3` in A, adds no second marker in B, computes repairs as attempts minus the snapshot (C: 0 so an ordinary target 1 repair without model and no attempt increment; D: 3 so it records `row 1 escalated | implModel repair round | allowed repairs 4` and dispatches target 1 with repair-model; E: 4 so it records the conformance reopen at attempts 7 and aborts pre-land without dispatch), and the exhaustion report prints `seed: 0 of 4`, the attempts value 7, `repairs: 4 of 4`, then every supplied decision line verbatim in order followed by the new reopen; F dispatches the seed without a model. Before failed because it wrote no pass marker in A, counted repairs against raw attempts (escalating C with a model, aborting D), and omitted the seed and repairs counters in E. No fact that Before held was lost. One fragility to tighten: in E the attempts counter is printed as a bare `7` with no label, which satisfies the fact as written but is hard to read; have the wording require a labelled line such as `row 1 attempts: 7` between the seed and repairs counters so the report stays unambiguous. Also note that B's After text says to write attempts 4 on the row while keeping the snapshot at 3; keep that distinction explicit in the wording so the snapshot is never confused with the row's live attempts value.
